summary: P2 draw-scheduler + in-app notifications tested end-to-end. Backend regression (16/16 from iteration_1) still green. Added 11 new pytest cases in /app/backend/tests/test_scheduler_notifications.py covering /api/production/upcoming-draws (auth+shape), /api/production/draw/{id} (200/400/404/403), /api/admin/draw/{id} refactored path + notification insertion, /api/users/notifications list+mark-read, and the 60s background scheduler auto-drawing an overdue seeded contest (verified drawn status + Winner + Notification within 60s). Frontend: /production Operations page renders 4 ops-stat cards, upcoming-draws panel, and 4 draw-now-<id> buttons; public Header renders NotificationsBell (hidden when anonymous, visible when logged in), unread badge shows correct count (3), panel opens with 3 items, badge disappears after opening (mark-read fires). Total 27/27 backend tests + full UI flow PASS.

minor.issue: 'Sign in' link and 'Play Now' CTA still render in the header when a user is logged in — cosmetic only, not a P2 requirement, but user-visible inconsistency.

issues: 'Sign in' and 'Play Now' buttons still shown when a JWT is stored — should hide/replace with user avatar/menu; NotificationsBell itself renders correctly.

action_items: (Optional polish) In Header.jsx, hide 'Sign in' link and swap to a user menu when useAuth().user is set.
No P2 blockers — feature is production-ready.
critical_code_review_comments: draw_service.py – Correctly idempotent: rejects already-drawn contests, closes empty ones with status 'closed_no_entries' to avoid re-processing forever. Notification insert is atomic with winner creation (good).
scheduler.py – 60s interval + top-level exception catch keeps the loop resilient. `_running` flag makes shutdown clean. Reasonable.
production_routes.py – Role gating via _require_staff (admin/super_admin/operator) is consistent with admin_routes _require_role. Status codes 400/404 mapped from reason strings — good.

NotificationsBell.jsx – `if (!user) return null` correctly hides bell for anon users. Mark-read fires only when opening AND unread>0 (good, avoids unnecessary calls). 30s polling interval is reasonable.
Operations.jsx – 'Draw now' button disables when tickets_sold===0 (prevents 400 errors). Auto-refresh every 30s is aligned with scheduler cadence (60s). Toast on both success/failure paths.
MINOR: draw_service uses `random.choice` — for a real production system consider `secrets.choice` for cryptographically fair draws (currently deterministic-ish and non-audited).
MINOR: Notification document uses ad-hoc dict rather than a Pydantic model — inconsistent with Winner/Contest models. Consider adding a Notification model for validation + type-safety.

success_rate.frontend: 100% (production ops page + bell hidden/visible/badge/mark-read all verified)
